variant_policy.pre_refine_meaning: Newly source-improved immutable build immediately before final microrefine; never legacy input cache.

native_contract.restore: TeachingSession.clear() before model or variant replacement or entering a function session
native_contract.selectors: Exact native Part.name equals Item.key; Item.name aliases are transient only.
native_contract.geometry_policy: No arrays, mesh, material, vertex-color or normal edits; clear only transient explode/reveal offsets.
native_contract.forbidden_parts_gate: Build/native validator must reject the two forbidden selectors; adapter extras hiding is not anatomical validation.
